name: General Aptitude
description: Verbal and numerical aptitude common to all GATE papers.

name: Engineering Mathematics
description: Linear algebra, calculus, differential equations, complex variables, probability.

name: Networks, Signals and Systems
description: Circuit analysis, signals, LTI systems, Fourier, Laplace and Z transforms.

name: Electronic Devices & Analog Circuits
description: Diodes, BJTs, MOSFETs, amplifiers, feedback, oscillators, op-amps.

name: Digital Circuits
description: Boolean algebra, combinational/sequential circuits, converters, microprocessors.

name: Control Systems
description: Feedback, transfer functions, stability, root locus, Bode, compensators.

name: Communications
description: Analog/digital modulation, information theory, random processes, noise.

name: Electromagnetics
description: Vector calculus, Maxwell equations, transmission lines, waveguides, antennas.
